description: Application settings for Binance Quantitative Trading Bot

_comments.AutoReconnect: Automatically reconnect to Binance API on connection loss
_comments.EnableNotifications: Enable push notifications via Telegram or DingTalk
_comments.Environment: Deployment environment: Development, Staging, or Production
_comments.RefreshIntervalSeconds: Data refresh interval in seconds (minimum: 1, recommended: 5)
_comments.LogLevel: Logging level: Debug, Info, Warning, Error, Critical
_comments.TelegramBotToken: Telegram Bot API token for notifications (optional)
_comments.TelegramChatId: Telegram Chat ID to send notifications (optional)
